name: visual-impression
description: Restore the AI coding conversation that was running in each terminal, per project. Works locally and over Remote SSH.

commands.title: Visual Impression: Forget this workspace's history

visualImpression.promptOnStartup.description: When a project is opened and agent terminals were recorded here before, offer to bring them back.

visualImpression.scanIntervalSeconds.description: How often to re-check which agent each terminal is running. An agent started inside an existing terminal is picked up on the next scan.

visualImpression.historyDays.description: Forget terminals that closed more than this many days ago.

visualImpression.reuseRevivedTerminals.description: When restoring, resume into a terminal VS Code revived by itself rather than opening another one. This is what keeps a split layout: VS Code rebuilds the arrangement, and a conversation resumed into one of those terminals lands inside it.
